static_traits.social_status: 有少数亲密朋友可倾诉，但尚not yet与他们讨论此具体问题
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems experienced; no psychotherapy received; no significant physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I tend toward black-and-white thinking; as long as one negative aspect stands out, I ignore any positive aspects in the experience. This way of thinking makes me feel pain, especially in social situations.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize my negative thinking patterns are affecting my enjoyment of life and social interactions.
growth_experiences: 青少年时期开始形成对经历与事件的高期待与完美化标准；随着时间推移，在社交活动、演出及日常互动中只要出现一个负面方面，便忽略积极面、将整体体验定义为糟糕，近几个月该模式更为突出，常感到失望与not满。

core_beliefs: 只有完美的体验才有价值
一处瑕疵会毁掉整件事

special_situations.event: 独立音乐会出现音响技术故障
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果活动出现任何瑕疵，整体就等于失败、not值得
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过写日记尝试强调积极面，但回顾时仍将注意力集中于负面细节
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这场演出被毁了，真是糟糕的一晚

special_situations.event: 工作团建活动中食物很差
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果体验中存在not合意的部分，就意味着整场活动是失败和浪费
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 事后只谈论not好的部分，忽略其他积极体验

special_situations.event: 社交场合中出现小的not顺（如安排not完美或临时技术问题）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 事情应该按我期待的方式完美进行，否则就是糟糕的经历
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 为活动设定过高且僵化的期待，以期避免失望
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次社交活动变得很糟，not值得来

special_situations.event: 独立音乐会的开场演出很差
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果某个环节表现not佳，就代表整晚都很糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将关注点集中在表现not佳的环节，把其他积极部分视为without足轻重
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 开场很差，所以整晚都糟糕

core_conflict.wish: 渴望拥有近乎完美的体验，以获得满足与掌控感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕not完美带来的失望与not满
defense_goal: 以严格的评价标准和非黑即白的判断来避免失望

object_relations.self_representation: 苛求完美、容易因瑕疵而negate整体的体验者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人或活动被视为要么完美要么糟糕、可能令我失望的对象

manifestations: In social activities, performances, and daily interactions, when one negative aspect appears, has difficulty experiencing meaning and value, and classifies the whole experience as 'terrible'
常将积极片段视为微not足道，从而削弱对事件意义的把握
outcomes: Interpersonal relationships中的误解与冲突增多

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 长期对事件设定完美化期待
在回顾经历时以外在完美标准评判自我与他人
咨询开始时表示对敞开心扉有些Anxiety与谨慎

positive_force: 具备一定的自我Reflection与记录能力（尝试通过写日记关注积极面）
Has a few close friends who can provide emotional support
求助动机明确、态度积极
negative_force: Excessively high expectations and perfectionistic tendencies
非黑即白思维与心理过滤，倾向忽视积极面
在社交场合中的失望与not满加剧，导致误解与冲突
对事件Overall evaluation受单一负面细节主导

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交与娱乐活动中以非黑即白方式评价并只关注负面
antecedent: 社交活动、演出或日常互动中出现小瑕疵或与期待not符
对活动抱有过高且完美化的期待
target_behavior.core_reason: 长期高期待与完美主义倾向，使其将局部瑕疵视为整体失败
target_behavior.function: 避免主观上的失望感，维持对体验的控制与确定性
target_behavior.consequence: 整体情绪与享受度下降；与他人产生误解与冲突；社交满意度降低
